card.name: Citation details in parasite-disease texts
card.fires_on: Punctuation, digits and name starts inside references and lists in texts about malaria, Chagas disease vectors and insect parasites like Wolbachia. It fires on year digits, author initials, commas in species lists and DOI slashes.
